title: If you have to sit in traffic, it’s much more tolerable in a Ferrari 296 GTS
text: If you have to sit in traffic, it’s much more tolerable in a Ferrari 296 GTS. It’s like sitting in the Space Shuttle waiting to count down to launch. My tour guide was Marc, and he was great. He guided me through the streets of Barcelona and then through the twisties to Tibidabo. I aired it out a few times, but it’s not my car and we followed all traffic laws. I’d definitely do this again, and its cost per use is much better than getting your own supercar. Thanks Marc and Happy Birthday!
author: Larry C

title: Most thrilling experience of my life!
text: I had such an amazing time driving the Lamborghini Tecnica. It handled like a dream. The car was very well kept and the check-in process was smooth and easy. The instructor, Arnau, was particularly awesome. His English was great and he was extremely knowledgeable about the car and the local rides. He was so easy to talk to and very calm. I highly recommend and I can’t wait for my next Drive Me Barcelona experience!
author: andrewhF8108NX

title: Awesome experience!
text: Excellent texperience!! Omar our guide was great! Great drive around Barcelona and was very informative.  Would highly recommend!
author: 1970chevelle

title: Great experience and no issues
text: Excellent experience, no issues. I decided to drive the car myself, and had a co driver driving in front of us. I was a bit sceptic to this concept, but I was really nice to have someone to lead the way. Don’t expect this to be a race drive, it’s a scenic drive, hence I would recommend a convertible. You do get the opportunity to hear the engine revs, but not at high speed. I think we went max 80 kmt. Thank you to JC for arranging this.
author: 828PeterC

title: An incredible driving experience! You must Book!
text: In November 2023, I booked a surprise ride for my husband in a Ferrari Portofino for his 50th birthday. The messages were answered immediately and I got good information about the different driving routes. We booked the Tibidabo route and we were really satisfied! Juan took a lot of pictures and videos of us with our own phone, thank you for this experience! The sun was shining and we were able to open the roof. Juan and his team are gold! When we come to Barcelona again, we will definitely book a driving experience with them again. Thank you!!
author: 75Sari

title: Awesome
text: I booked the Ferrari 40 minute driving experience as a surprise for my husband. He absolutely loved it. I went in the back so also got to experience the ride of the awesome car. Alex the instructor was a really friendly, great guy. Definitely worth doing if you want to do something a bit special whist visiting Barcelona. Would highly recommend.
author: Wendleech1

title: An Amazing Time In Barcelona
text: WOW!  What a great experience this was.  After a number of visits to Barcelona we were looking for something a little different to do and Drive Me Barcelona came through in a very big way.  After a few e-mails with the very helpful folks at their office we settled on the mountain drive.  Their driver, Alex, showed up exactly on time at our hotel and after giving us a quick rundown on our chosen car - a 2022 Ferrari Portofino M - we were off for an hour and a half drive in the hills around Barcelona.
